description:
You are the HR Director at Apex Structural Engineering. You need to create a digital, fillable 'New Hire Data Sheet' for onboarding new employees. Use Apache OpenOffice Writer to create a form that users can fill out on their computer. 

1. Open Apache OpenOffice Writer.
2. Read the specifications in '/home/ga/Documents/form_specs.json' for the required fields and layout.
3. Insert the company logo found at '/home/ga/Documents/apex_logo.png' at the top.
4. Use the 'Form Controls' toolbar (View > Toolbars > Form Controls) to insert interactive fields:
   - Use 'Text Box' controls for text inputs (Name, Address, etc.).
   - Use 'Date Field' control for the Start Date.
   - Use 'CheckBox' controls for the compliance items.
5. Add clear text labels next to each control.
6. Save the document as '/home/ga/Documents/Apex_New_Hire_Form.odt'.
